about.title: About ClassFlow
about.subtitle: A school timetable management and optimization application built with ASP.NET Core, C++, Entity Framework Core and JavaScript.
about.overview.title: Project overview
about.overview.p1: ClassFlow is a web application for preparing school timetable data, running timetable optimization and presenting the generated schedule in a clear and filterable form.
about.overview.p2: The project combines a browser-based user interface, an ASP.NET Core backend, a PostgreSQL database and an external C++ optimization engine. Each layer has a separate responsibility, which keeps the application easier to develop, test and extend.
about.what.title: What ClassFlow does
about.what.p1: Users can manage the main resources required to build a timetable: teachers, classes, subjects, rooms and lesson requirements.
about.what.p2: ClassFlow also supports resource availability, scheduling rules, optimization settings, preprocessing validation and live optimization progress. When optimization completes, the generated timetable is shown in a table that can be filtered by class, teacher and room.
about.architecture.title: Architecture
about.architecture.p1: JSON is used as the data contract between the ASP.NET Core backend and the C++ engine. SignalR is used to send optimization progress updates from the server to the browser.
about.technologies.title: Technologies used
about.tech.aspnet: Web API, controllers, services, dependency injection, external process execution and application orchestration.
about.tech.cpp: External optimization engine responsible for generating and evaluating timetable candidates.
about.tech.postgresql: Relational database used to store organizations, users, teachers, classes, rooms, subjects, requirements and scheduling data.
about.tech.ef: Database access, domain models, migrations and PostgreSQL integration through the Npgsql provider.
about.tech.signalr: Live optimization progress updates sent from the server to the dashboard.
about.tech.javascript: API communication, forms, navigation, table rendering, filtering, CSV export and browser storage.
about.tech.htmlcss: Responsive application layout, resource pages, forms, tables and the Classic Ink visual theme.
about.features.title: Implemented features
about.features.demo: Demo login with prepared school datasets.
about.features.resources: Management of teachers, classes, rooms, subjects and lesson requirements.
about.features.availability: Weekly availability configuration for teachers, classes and rooms.
about.features.ga: Configurable genetic algorithm parameters and penalty values.
about.features.integration: ASP.NET Core integration with an external C++ optimization engine.
about.features.filters: Filterable timetable result by class, teacher and room.
about.features.csv: CSV export and storage of the latest result in the browser.
about.goals.title: Project goals
about.goals.p1: ClassFlow is both a practical application and a learning project. It is used to develop experience in modern C++, ASP.NET Core, PostgreSQL, database design, frontend development, process integration, real-time communication and deployment.
about.goals.p2: A major design goal is to keep the optimization engine independent from the web interface. The C++ engine focuses on optimization, the backend prepares and validates data, and the browser presents the result in a form useful to the user.
about.status.title: Current status
about.status.p1: ClassFlow is a working prototype under active development. Resource management, availability, optimization settings, timetable generation, progress reporting, filtering and CSV export are already available.
about.status.p2: The current development work focuses on improving diagnostics and making execution of the external optimization engine reliable in the server environment.
about.next.title: Next steps
about.next.diagnostics: Improve server-side process diagnostics and optimization logs.
about.next.storage: Store optimization runs and generated timetables in the database.
about.next.constraints: Expand timetable constraints and optimization quality measures.
about.next.auth: Complete registration and regular user authentication.
about.next.deployment: Continue deployment hardening and production preparation.
